title: Implementation quality
description: Use real contracts, focused changes, explicit errors, and evidence-backed verification.
purpose: Deliver maintainable behavior without masking the root cause.
requirements: implementation-quality/read-contracts: Read the real files, schemas, interfaces, and tests before describing or changing behavior.
implementation-quality/root-cause: Fix the root cause supported by evidence instead of masking symptoms or adding unrelated refactoring.
implementation-quality/smallest-diff: Make the smallest sound change that satisfies the contract and keeps interfaces clear.
implementation-quality/error-paths: Handle expected errors explicitly, do not introduce placeholders or dead code, and verify failure paths as well as success.

implementation-quality/minimal-comments: Default to no code comments; use clear names and small units; add only short comments for non-obvious intent, a necessary constraint, or required notices; preserve existing comments outside the task and remove only new comments that restate the code.
invariants: Read real contracts, fix the root cause, keep the smallest sound diff, handle errors, and leave no placeholders.
